name: ether
description: Local Ether 4.0 document workflow control for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, construct, repair, preview, and explicitly run one Ether 4.0 .ether document through typed MCP tools. Graph changes are one undoable transaction; runs require a plan-bound Run Permit.

skillHighlights.useWhen: Translate a creative goal into a safe Ether 4.0 document workflow.
Construct or repair a graph or module in one undoable transaction.
Design model-aware Codex Worker chains and output contracts.
Curate document-scoped references and their roles.
Preview, permit, start, cancel, or retry a declared run.
Preview and instantiate an executable recipe.
Build review checkpoints, decisions, and collection routing.
Inspect artifacts, collections, lineage, and export preparation.
Inspect document health and guide a repair.

defaultPrompt: Use $ether-director to inspect this Ether document and propose a tailored graph.
Use $ether-graph-architect to apply the approved graph transaction with temporary references.
Use $ether-run-operator to preview a plan; do not execute unless I explicitly request it.
Use $ether-project-doctor to inspect and repair this Ether document.
